astral.line: The ascended masters and the astral plane
stanza: At the Inn of the Seventh Ray
To tell me what he knew about Saint Germain
And he told me about chakras and karma and the purple flame
The ascended masters and the astral plane

astral.line: A moon full of stars and astral cars
astral.lineNext: And all the figures I used to see
stanza: I jumped in the river and what did I see?
A moon full of stars and astral cars
And all the figures I used to see
All my lovers were there with me
And we all went to heaven in a little row boat
